caption: The drawing depicts a full-length dress with long sleeves, shown from the back. The main color of the dress is a light green, with additional shading in darker green and grey. Decorative elements and outlines on the dress are done in purple and blue lines, particularly on the skirt’s lower area, neckline, buttons, cuffs, and seams. There are three-lobed floral or leaf motifs, also outlined in purple, arranged in symmetrical patterns along the skirt and at the collar. The bodice has vertical purple lines running down from the shoulders to the waist, which is cinched with a matching belt. Pockets with vertical slits are present at each hip. To the left of the main dress, there is a detailed drawing of a choker or neck accessory colored in green and purple. Below this, there is a pencil sketch of a sleeve with similar embroidery motifs. To the right of the dress, there are two additional pencil sketches showing the garment’s trim and floral motif design in greater detail, without color. The background is a plain, off-white paper.
title: Silk Gown
